design_philosophy.theme_strategy: Day Glass (Light Mode) with Deep Night option
design_philosophy.rtl_strategy: Mirror everything. Navigation starts right. Back buttons point right.

layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#F3F4F6] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-[1.02] transition-all duration-300 rounded-xl h-12 font-bold
buttons.secondary: bg-white/50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 hover:bg-white/80 hover:border-blue-300 transition-all rounded-xl h-12 font-medium

cards.glass: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/50 shadow-sm rounded-2xl p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
cards.product: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group

inputs.glass: bg-white/50 border-white/60 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-200/50 rounded-xl h-12 backdrop-blur-sm transition-all

navigation.bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/50 h-20 flex items-center justify-around z-50 pb-2

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. RTL: Add 'dir=rtl' to the root <html> or <body> tag immediately.
3. FONT: Import 'Tajawal' from Google Fonts in index.css (@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Tajawal:wght@400;500;700;800&display=swap');).
4. THEME: Update 'tailwind.config.js' and 'index.css' with the provided color palette. Use CSS variables for flexibility.
5. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components. Remove default 'rounded-md' and use 'rounded-xl' or 'rounded-2xl'. Increase padding. Add backdrop-blur to cards.
6. ANIMATION: Wrap page content in <motion.div> with the 'page_transition' variant.
7. MOCK DATA: Create a 'mockData.js' file for products, orders, and user info to make the UI functional.
8. ALIEXPRESS: Use an iframe for the AliExpress browse page, but wrap it in a nice glass container with a custom header.
9. FILE EXTENSION: Use .jsx for all React components.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
